text: What a quaint little village... I think I will like it here.
This statue is quite impressive. I wonder who it represents.

1.name: Swordmaster Deryk
text: Good evening, sir. I am Swordmaster Deryk, at your service. I have come to offer my skills to the village.

2.name: Village elder Grahan
text: Ah, Swordmaster Deryk, welcome to our village. We could use your expertise.

3.name: Swordmaster Deryk
text: Thank you for your invitation, sir.

4.name: Village elder Grahan
text: As you know, lately, we have seen an increase in monster activity in the area. I would like you to help teach our villagers how to defend themselves.

5.name: Swordmaster Deryk
text: Of course, I would be honored to help. I will start with the teaching tomorrow morning.

6.name: Village elder Grahan
text: Thank you, Deryk. I am sure the villagers will benefit greatly from your knowledge.
One moment, please. I'd like to settle in first.

1.name: Swordmaster Deryk
text: Good evening, madam innkeeper. I am Swordmaster Deryk. I have a reservation for a room and I would like to check in.

2.name: Innkeeper
text: Good evening, Swordmaster Deryk. Welcome to our inn. I have your room ready.

3.name: Swordmaster Deryk
text: Thank you, innkeeper. I appreciate your hospitality.

4.name: Innkeeper
text: If you need anything during your stay, please don't hesitate to ask.

5.name: Swordmaster Deryk
text: I will, thank you. I look forward to my stay here. Tomorrow morning, I will begin teaching the villagers in self-defense.

6.name: Innkeeper
text: That sounds wonderful. The villagers will surely benefit from your expertise.
Good evening. I'm swordmaster Deryk.
I will be teaching the villagers in self-defense, starting tomorrow morning. If you wish to join, please come to the village square at 09:00.
Ah, I see you are eager to learn. Very well, I will teach everyone in your party right now.
Now everyone in your party can use the ability {COLOR=BLUE}Focused Strike{COLOR=BLACK} in battle. It's variation of the regular Strike ability.
If you want me to teach Focused Strike to other party members, please bring them here. I will teach them as well.
